overview: This paper formalizes the conjecture that certain neural networks (particularly those using ReLU and similar activations) inherently preserve subspace clustering structure, providing theoretical bounds via Davis-Kahan sin(Θ) theorem and validating empirically that networks learn weights preserving clustering structure without explicit regularization, across synthetic and real-world datasets.

modules.name: Union-of-Subspaces Data Generator
modules.description: Generates synthetic data matrices following the subspace clustering model X*=UV+Z, where data columns lie in a union of K low-dimensional subspaces with configurable subspace dimensions, noise levels, and sample counts. Supports construction of orthonormal bases Uk and coefficient matrices Vk, and orthogonalization of V to obtain the group-sparse block-diagonal matrix V̄.

modules.name: Projection Operator Module
modules.description: Computes the projection operator P(·) onto the principal r-dimensional row-space of a matrix, which encodes the subspace clustering structure. Implements SVD-based projection and extracts the support structure revealing cluster membership from the projection matrix entries.

modules.name: Spectral Gap and Perturbation Bound Checker
modules.description: Computes the spectral gap δ between the rth and (r+1)th singular values for pairs (X*,X), (WX*,WX), and (Y,WX), calculates the bound η from Theorem 3.1 involving noise norms and dimension, and determines whether the condition δ>η holds. Aggregates statistics on the probability of condition satisfaction across noise levels.

modules.name: Single-Layer ReLU Autoencoder
modules.description: Implements a single hidden layer feedforward autoencoder with configurable number of ReLU neurons, squared Frobenius reconstruction loss, and standard gradient descent optimization. Supports extraction of learned weight matrices W for projection distance analysis.

modules.name: Multi-Layer ReLU Feedforward Network
modules.description: Implements a deep feedforward network with configurable number of ReLU layers (e.g., 5 layers as in the paper), enabling extraction of intermediate representations X_ℓ, W_ℓX_ℓ, and Y_ℓ at each layer for per-layer projection distance tracking and clustering accuracy evaluation.

modules.name: Alternative Activation Network Module
modules.description: Implements feedforward networks with alternative activation functions including GELU and SiLU (Swish), with the same architecture as the multi-layer ReLU network, enabling comparison of clustering structure preservation across different nonlinearities.

modules.name: LSTM Architecture with ReLU
modules.description: Implements a 3-layer LSTM architecture with ReLU activations for sequential processing, adapted for subspace clustering analysis, enabling projection distance tracking across recurrent layers to validate that clustering preservation extends beyond feedforward architectures.

modules.name: CNN Architecture Module
modules.description: Implements a 3-layer convolutional neural network with configurable activation functions, serving as a comparative architecture where the convolution operator is expected to disrupt rather than preserve the original subspace clustering structure, demonstrating the specificity of linear+activation preservation.

modules.name: Transformer Architecture Module
modules.description: Implements a 4-layer Transformer architecture with different activation functions, serving as a comparative architecture where the attention mechanism does not inherently preserve subspace clustering structure, contrasting with ReLU-type networks that cluster via the closed-form projection solution.

modules.name: Training Loop with Projection Distance Tracking
modules.description: Custom training loop that computes and logs projection distances ∥P(X*)-P(Y)∥, ∥P(X)-P(WX)∥, and ∥P(Y)-P(WX)∥ at each epoch, tracking the evolution of clustering structure preservation throughout training. Supports gradient descent with configurable learning rate and reconstruction loss.

modules.name: Weight Initialization Strategy Module
modules.description: Implements and compares weight initialization strategies: standard random initialization (uniform in (-m^{1/2}, m^{1/2})), nonnegative initialization (uniform in unit interval), and Kaiming/Xavier initialization. Validates that nonnegative initialization with nonnegative data automatically preserves clustering structure at training start and constitutes a local optimum.

modules.name: Clustering Evaluation Metrics
modules.description: Computes clustering accuracy metrics including Accuracy (ACC), Normalized Mutual Information (NMI), and Adjusted Rand Index (ARI) by extracting cluster assignments from the projection operator P(Y) (entries above threshold ε/2 indicate same-cluster membership), with comparison against ground-truth labels.

modules.name: Real-World Dataset Preprocessor
modules.description: Preprocesses 12+ real-world datasets (MNIST, CIFAR-10, EMNIST, SVHN, K-MNIST, Fashion-MNIST, Flowers-102, Food-101, USPS, STL-10, Oxford DTD, Oxford Pet, EuroSAT) including image normalization, flattening to vector format, and train/test splitting. Handles dataset-specific format requirements and ensures nonnegative feature representation where applicable.

modules.name: Synthetic Experiment Runner
modules.description: Orchestrates synthetic data experiments varying noise variance s², computing δ and η bounds, recording the probability of Theorem 3.1 conditions holding over multiple independent trials (e.g., 100 trials per noise level). Aggregates results into probability-vs-noise curves for the bound degradation analysis.

modules.name: Multi-Dataset Validation Runner
modules.description: Runs clustering structure preservation experiments across all real-world datasets with 5-layer ReLU networks, tracking projection distances over 200 epochs per dataset. Aggregates results across multiple trials for cross-dataset validation of the theoretical findings.

modules.name: Visualization and Analysis Module
modules.description: Generates all paper figures including: (1) probability of condition satisfaction vs. noise level, (2) projection distance evolution over epochs for single and multi-layer networks, (3) per-layer projection distance and clustering accuracy evolution, (4) comparison plots across activation functions and architectures (GELU, SiLU, LSTM, CNN, Transformer), and (5) projection matrix heatmaps revealing cluster structure.

modules.name: Configuration and Experiment Management
modules.description: Manages experiment configurations including dataset parameters (m, n, K, rk), noise levels, network architectures (layer count, neuron count, activation type), training hyperparameters (learning rate, epochs), and initialization strategies. Supports YAML/JSON configuration files, experiment tracking, and result persistence for reproducibility across 100 independent trials per configuration.
